signature.name: VTask.of
signature.type: (R : Type u_1) -> [Semiring R] -> (ι : Type u_2) -> [Preorder ι] -> (G : ι → Type u_3) -> [(i : ι) → AddCommMonoid (G i)] -> [(i : ι) → Module R (G i)] -> (f : (i j : ι) → i ≤ j → G i →ₗ[R] G j) -> [DecidableEq ι] -> (i : ι) -> G i →ₗ[R] Module.DirectLimit G f

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The map VTask.of is total and well-defined for all valid inputs with no junk-value or boundary conventions needed.
